comments_text: Function: Antimicrobial and mast cell degranulating peptide which probably acts by forming pores in membranes (PubMed:28546807, PubMed:28855917). Active against both Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacterial strains as well as against yeasts (PubMed:28546807, PubMed:28855917). Has leishmanicidal activity (IC50=25uM)(PubMed:28855917). Has little hemolytic activity (PubMed:28546807, PubMed:28855917)
reference_text: J Venom Anim Toxins Incl Trop Dis. 2017 Aug 29;23:40.
